gloss: way of speaking; manner of speech

definitions.gloss: way of speaking; manner of speech; tone
definitions.explanation: The characteristic manner, style, or tone in which someone speaks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{話|はな}しぶり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いている→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: His manner of speaking is calm.

examples.japanese: {話|はな}しぶり⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怒|おこ}っている→怒る：00876_okoru⟧ようだ。
examples.english: Judging from the way she speaks, she seems to be angry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{話|はな}しぶり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{説得力|せっとくりょく}がある→説得力がある：25151_settokuryokugaaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}ける→耳を傾ける：06903_mimiwokatamukeru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher's manner of speaking is persuasive, so the students listen attentively.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (speaking/talk) + ⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧ (manner/style). The suffix ⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧ attaches to nouns and verb stems to describe someone's characteristic way of doing something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {話|はな}しぶり⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧: to judge from someone's way of speaking
- ⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧{話|はな}しぶり: a calm manner of speaking
- ⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧な{話|はな}しぶり: a gentle way of speaking
- {話|はな}しぶり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change one's way of speaking

RELATED ぶり WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧っぷり: way of eating
- ⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧っぷり: way of drinking
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: way of working, work performance
- ⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: way of living, lifestyle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧: way of speaking — more common and general; focuses on how one speaks technically
- ⟦{口調|くちょう}→口調：11803_kuchou⟧: tone of voice — emphasizes intonation and emotional quality
- ⟦{口|くち}ぶり→口ぶり：15424_kuchiburi⟧: way of speaking, tone — very similar to {話|はな}しぶり but slightly more focused on phrasing and word choice
